definitions.explanation: To physically handle or manage something with care.
To stock or sell products; to provide services for a particular area.

definitions.gloss: to treat, to deal with (a person or matter)
definitions.explanation: To treat or deal with someone or something in a particular way.

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}は{丁寧|ていねい}に{取|と}り{扱|あつか}ってください。
この{店|みせ}は{輸入|ゆにゅう}{食品|しょくひん}を{取|と}り{扱|あつか}っている。
{お客様|おきゃくさま}を{大切|たいせつ}に{取|と}り{扱|あつか}うことが{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Treating customers with care is fundamental.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{扱|あつか}い{説明書|せつめいしょ}をよく{読|よ}んでからご{使用|しよう}ください。
examples.english: Please read the instruction manual carefully before use.
examples.notes: Uses the noun form 取り扱い (handling)

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Compound verb: {取|と}る + {扱|あつか}う. Pattern: Xを{取|と}り{扱|あつか}う (handle X / deal with X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {取|と}り{扱|あつか}っている = 'deals with' or 'carries (products).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{丁寧|ていねい}に{取|と}り{扱|あつか}う (handle carefully)
・{商品|しょうひん}を{取|と}り{扱|あつか}う (carry products)
・{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い{注意|ちゅうい} (handle with care)
・{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い{説明書|せつめいしょ} (instruction manual)

NOUN FORM: {取|と}り{扱|あつか}い is commonly used as a noun meaning 'handling' or 'treatment.'
